Title: n8n: Git Node fetch/pull/pushTags Operations Bypass Sandbox Path Restriction
Description: Authenticated n8n users with workflow create/execute rights could use the Git node's fetch, pull, or push-tags operations to bypass the repository-path containment checks that already protected clone and push. By pointing an allowlisted remote configuration value at a local path outside the intended sandbox, an attacker could pull an arbitrary local git repository into the workspace and subsequently read its files and history.
AffectedVersions: All versions before 1.123.67, all versions starting from 2.0.0-rc.0 before 2.31.5, all versions starting from 2.32.0 before 2.32.1
NotImpacted: All versions starting from 1.123.67 before 2.0.0-rc.0, all versions starting from 2.31.5 before 2.32.0, all versions starting from 2.32.1
